authority.purpose: Authoritative minimum semantic runtime-master matrix for the fixed eight-person cast across every Day 1 node and Story Director event.

namingRules.fixedCast: {baseAssetId}--fixed-{fixedCastIds joined by hyphen in resolver order}

fieldSemantics.perspectiveCharacterId: Non-null only when the master is keyed to one selected protagonist. Shared npc, unordered-pair, fixed-cast, and current-eight masters use null.
fieldSemantics.applicablePerspectiveCharacterIds: Selected protagonist ids that may resolve to this one semantic master.
fieldSemantics.participantIds: Identity-bearing event participants for a shared master; empty for a perspective-only master.
fieldSemantics.identityCast: Exact recognizable cast required by the runtime resolver. Set and cardinality must both match the manifest asset.
fieldSemantics.status: existingApprovedReusable only when the current runtime manifest has a non-empty path, an allowed approved status, an exact identityCast, and event-specific content QA satisfies the current product contract; otherwise requiresGeneration.

checks: asset status is ready or approved-runtime
manifest identityCast has exact set equality with required identityCast
manifest identityCast has exact cardinality equality with required identityCast
